_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so the extinction mechanism (energy-extinction.js) does not falsely retire activations. Extinction retires an activation when NONE of its free-text diagnosticTriggers appear in the live activeTriggers set; but activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes (e.g. grid_stress) + active diagnosis ids (e.g. GRID_COLLAPSE) (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53), whose vocabulary never textually equals a diagnosticTrigger like "AI compute demand surge". This table maps each condition-code and diagnosis id to the activation brainNodeIds / diagnosticTriggers that should count as still-active when it fires.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(pulse-engine classify, L181-211)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies / primaryIndicators, L47-117)--> diagnosis id --(energy.json issues[]._authored circuit; the adapter itself uses is._authored||is.circuits, L64-69)--> circuit nodeIds --(brainNodeId match)--> activation.diagnosticTriggers. The diagnoses section is the strongest link (pure data, no inference); condition-codes add the two pulse-engine hops.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is FOLDED into a condition-code (its nodes counted) only when the code's evidence family satisfies the diagnosis requiredFamilies, OR the code is a named primaryIndicator, OR (for stress catch-all codes) the code is a contract indicator of SYSTEMIC_ENERGY_STRESS whose catchAllBlocked is false. Codes that appear only as another diagnosis's secondaryConfirmation are listed under secondaryDiagnoses but NOT folded (bias toward not over-marking, except where folding is the only grounded link).
_provenance.discipline: No link is invented. Condition-codes and diagnoses with no defensible chain are reported in "unmapped". Trigger strings are copied verbatim from energy.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.note: Generated deterministically from the above sources. Read-only reference data; nothing here writes energy.json or fires extinction.

Needs an authored condition/diagnosis link before extinction should touch it.
